description:
### 🎨 Gboard Patches v1.0.0 — Material 3 Expressive & Android 17 Volumetric Features

* **Material 3 Expressive UI:** Complete overhaul of Gboard Patches Settings Activity conforming to Material 3 Expressive design tokens, vibrant tonal containers, high-contrast expressive indigo palette, and 24dp rounded cards.
* **Custom 3D Emoji Font (.ttf):** Built-in loader supporting custom TrueType emoji fonts including Google Emoji 3D (Android 17 Preview style) without requiring root.
* **Pixel Voice Typing & Rambler:** Universal Google Pixel Rambler offline voice typing support unlocked for English (US) and English (India).
* **AI Writing Tools:** Proofread, rewrite, and tone editing features unlocked across all locales.
* **Morphe Integration:** Full compatibility with Morphe Manager custom patch sources.
